text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic wardrobe product image, pure white background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, no person, skin, body parts, visible mannequin or stand. Entire object fully visible. Washed charcoal relaxed short sleeve T-shirt, gray relaxed cargo trousers with thigh pockets, simple black shoes conservatively completed below crop.
original_prompt: Create one photorealistic wardrobe catalog product image, pure white seamless background, soft neutral studio illumination, truthful fabric texture, portrait 2:3. No human, face, hair, skin, body parts, visible mannequin, hanger or stand. No text, logos, watermark, border or scene. Entire object fully inside frame with margins. Use ONLY the outfit at position 左 in the reference. Preserve its exact garment cuts, colors, layers and shoes. Render a single coherent EMPTY hollow garment ensemble front-facing in a neutral symmetrical stance, sleeves visibly empty. Washed charcoal relaxed short sleeve T-shirt, gray pleated relaxed trousers, simple black shoes conservatively completed below crop. Remove ALL detachable accessories: bags, hats, belts, ties, necklaces, jewelry, sunglasses, decorative trouser chains and scarves. Keep knitted sweaters and sewn waist ties as clothing. Exclude handheld flowers, food, books, drinks, phones, cigarettes, instruments and luggage props. If reference repeats the same outfit at multiple scales, show it ONCE. No collage, no alternate outfits.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
